background: UOB is Singapore's third-largest bank, family-influenced and conservatively run, funded by Singapore dollar deposits and lending across Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia and Vietnam, with a consumer franchise enlarged by the Citigroup businesses it bought in the region.
synthesis: Rated AA on average across all three, the weakest of them at AA-, all on a stable outlook. Against Asian banks leverage of 6.3% is in the top quarter and LCR of 152% above the peer median, while CET1 of 14.6% is below the median and NSFR of 112% in the bottom quarter. None of the ratios has moved materially over the past four periods to 30 Sep 2026.
